conversation_summary: The intake system conducted a thorough and professional interview. It followed all required protocols, including asking for repeatable fields until the patient indicated no further entries, and correctly administered the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 questionnaires. The flow was logical and the system maintained a neutral, helpful tone throughout.
record_summary: The produced record is highly accurate and complete. All patient facts were correctly mapped to the appropriate fields. Questionnaire scores were calculated correctly, and the safety flag was correctly set to false based on the patient's responses.
